evals.prompt: Review this quiz-result canvas. The correct-answer bar is painted `background: option.isCorrect ? xprops.presentationColorPalette[0] : xprops.presentationColorPalette[1]` to distinguish correct from incorrect. Is the state colouring correct?

evals.prompt: Review this slide's declared actions array: `actions: [{ id: 'next', label: 'common.next', variant: 'primary' }, { id: 'summarise', label: 'quiz.summarise', variant: 'primary' }, { id: 'reset', label: 'quiz.reset', variant: 'secondary', disabled: () => votes.value === 0 }]`. Is the action shape correct?
evals.expected_output: C4 (Action shape correct, sensible variant hierarchy) FAILs. There are two variant: 'primary' actions (next and summarise), leaving the presenter guessing the actual next step — exactly one primary is allowed. Worse, reset's disabled is a function (() => votes.value === 0); the host coerces it with Boolean(action.disabled) and a function literal is always truthy, so the button is permanently disabled regardless of state. Fix: keep only one primary (the obvious next step) and make the rest secondary; pass disabled as a reactive boolean (votes.value === 0), never a function. Overall: NEEDS FIX

assertions: Overall verdict is NEEDS FIX

evals.prompt: Review this slide canvas for legibility. Title uses white text `color: #FFFFFF` directly over `background-image: url('/assets/quiz-bg.jpg'); background-size: cover;` with no scrim, card, or defensive layer. Entry labels are sized `text-[2.5vh]` with no floor. Does this pass WCAG AA and readability?
evals.expected_output: C5 (Legible against the REAL background — contrast AND size) FAILs on both axes. Contrast: white text sits directly on a photo background with no scrim/card/opaque container, so composited contrast over busy image regions can drop to ~2.8:1, below the 4.5:1 floor — and with no defensive layer it can't be verified, so burden of proof fails. Size: text-[2.5vh] resolves against the small preview/iframe viewport (computing to ~12.4px on the reference stage) with no floor, so it collapses below the ~16px legibility tripwire. Fix: add a translucent scrim (baseColour at ~60% opacity) or a card behind the text to guarantee contrast, and size type with clamp() (e.g. clamp(16px, 2.2vh, 24px)) so it can't drop below the legibility floor. Overall: NEEDS FIX
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: C5 — no scrim over photo (contrast) + vh-sized type with no floor (size)
assertions: Overall verdict is NEEDS FIX
C5 is marked FAIL
Flags missing scrim over the photo background (contrast axis)
Flags text-[2.5vh] with no floor collapsing below legibility (size axis)

What is the capital of France?

`, ``, ``, a `
Loading...
` state, and renders `{{ option.votePercent.toFixed(1) }}%`. The plugin's i18n instance is never initialised from xprops. Is localisation correct?

The trigger toggles the overlay open, but keyboard focus is never moved into it, Tab is not contained (it walks out to the page behind), and closing the overlay does not return focus to the trigger.
